response.sql:
WITH district_accounts AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id,
    COUNT(*) as account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) as total_accounts,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district_id) FROM account) as num_districts
)
SELECT 
  da.district_id,
  da.account_count,
  CAST(da.account_count AS REAL) / t.total_accounts as share,
  CAST(da.account_count AS REAL) / t.total_accounts - 1.0 / t.num_districts as difference
FROM district_accounts da
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "Each branch district (account.district_id)" includes only districts that have at least one account in the account table, not all districts in the district table. The phrase is interpreted as "for each distinct value of account.district_id."

alternatives.interpretation: If the request intends to include all districts from the district table (even those with zero accounts), the average share would be calculated over all districts in district table, and districts with no accounts would have share=0 and negative difference values.
alternatives.sql:
WITH district_accounts AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id,
    COUNT(*) as account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
all_districts AS (
  SELECT 
    d.district_id,
    COALESCE(da.account_count, 0) as account_count
  FROM district d
  LEFT JOIN district_accounts da ON d.district_id = da.district_id
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) as total_accounts,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM district) as num_districts
)
SELECT 
  ad.district_id,
  ad.account_count,
  CAST(ad.account_count AS REAL) / t.total_accounts as share,
  CAST(ad.account_count AS REAL) / t.total_accounts - 1.0 / t.num_districts as difference
FROM all_districts ad
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
